# Feature status

Feature roadmap updated September 2026 (as shown on the website).
AVAILABLE = live today. LIMITED = only in the products named, partly, or done by our team. ROLLING_OUT = being built, not live yet. PLANNED = on the roadmap, no date. NOT_OFFERED = ZUGEE does not do it. UNVERIFIED = not confirmed.

| id | Capability | Status | What to say |
|---|---|---|---|
| gst_calculation_help | Working out GST on an amount or invoice | AVAILABLE | The assistant can work out an educational GST breakdown (taxable value, CGST/SGST or IGST, total) with the calculate_gst_invoice tool. It is an estimate, not tax advice or a tax invoice. |
| multi_branch | Multiple branches | AVAILABLE | Starter covers 1 branch; Growth covers multiple branches; Enterprise covers unlimited branches. The branch count is part of your quote. |
| roles_permissions | Staff logins and role-based permissions | AVAILABLE | Each person signs in with their own login and sees only what their role allows (for example lab staff in ZUGEE Care do not see billing). Role-based permissions are part of the Growth plan. |
| mobile_access | Using ZUGEE on a phone | AVAILABLE | ZUGEE products run in a web browser, so staff can use them on an Android phone as well as on a computer. |
| separate_products | Using two ZUGEE products together | AVAILABLE | Each ZUGEE product is separate software with its own login and data. You can use two side by side; they do not share a login or database. |
| setup_migration | Setup, data migration and training | AVAILABLE | Our team sets each customer up in about 14 days: we bring your data across from Excel or Tally exports, configure the product and train your staff. The setup fee is one-time. |
| data_export | Exporting your own data | AVAILABLE | You can export your data from the product in one click, and we will also send an export (such as Excel or CSV) if you ask. |
| contract_payment | Contract, payment method and cancellation | AVAILABLE | No minimum term or lock-in: cancel any time in writing. Payment is by UPI or bank transfer against our invoice; nothing is charged automatically (no auto-renewal). The monthly price is fixed for the life of the subscription. Refund rules are on /refund. |
| gst_billing | GST tax invoices (bills that charge GST) | LIMITED | ZUGEE Omni and ZUGEE Fleet raise GST bills with your business and customer details. The other products raise their own bills or receipts (fees, rent, bookings, OP/IP bills); for GST on those, your accountant handles the GST side using data we export. |
| tally_export | Giving your accountant data for Tally | LIMITED | Your accountant can keep using Tally. We export the billing data your accountant needs as Excel or CSV. It is an export for your accountant, not a file that imports straight into Tally and not a live Tally connection. |
| customer_credit_outstanding | Customer dues, credit sales and outstanding balances | LIMITED | Dues are tracked in ZUGEE Omni (payments set against bills, outstanding by customer), ZUGEE Water (outstanding by customer and route), ZUGEE Hostels (unpaid rent by tenant) and ZUGEE Estates (dues per booking). For other products, ask our team. |
| partial_payments | Part payments / instalments | LIMITED | Part payments are recorded in ZUGEE Hostels (rent in instalments), ZUGEE Resorts (advances and part payments) and ZUGEE Estates (token, booking amount and each instalment). For any other product, I can't confirm part payments. |
| inventory | Inventory and stock | LIMITED | ZUGEE Omni tracks stock, and each sale reduces stock as it is billed. ZUGEE Factory keeps raw-material and finished-goods inventory with purchase orders and GRNs. The other products are not built around stock. |
| custom_integrations | Custom integrations with other software (APIs, ERPs) | LIMITED | Custom integrations are scoped for Enterprise customers on a call. There is no ready list of integrations. |
| pricing_amounts | Prices and fees | LIMITED | Prices are not published. You pay a one-time setup fee plus a subscription based on the product, number of branches and users; the team sends a written quote after a short call. No hidden AMC charges. |
| online_payment_links | Online payment links / collecting payments online | ROLLING_OUT | Sending payment links and reminders to customers is coming soon. Today payments by cash, UPI or bank are recorded in the product. |
| whatsapp_messaging | WhatsApp messages and payment reminders sent from ZUGEE | ROLLING_OUT | Sending invoices, reminders and alerts on WhatsApp from inside ZUGEE is coming soon, not live. Today the outstanding list tells your staff whom to remind. |
| gstr1_report | A ready GSTR-1 report inside ZUGEE | PLANNED | A GSTR-1 report inside ZUGEE is planned but not available yet. Today your accountant prepares it from the billing data we export. |
| e_invoice | E-invoicing (IRN / QR code from the IRP) | PLANNED | E-invoicing (IRN generation) is planned but not available in ZUGEE yet. Until then, keep generating e-invoices the way you do now; do not say who does it for the visitor. |
| tally_direct | Direct Tally integration / Tally XML sync | PLANNED | A direct Tally export (Tally XML) is planned but not available yet. Today the data goes to your accountant as an export. |
| gst_return_filing | Filing GST returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B) from ZUGEE | NOT_OFFERED | ZUGEE does not file GST returns. Your accountant keeps filing (for example from Tally), and we export the billing data they need. |
| gst_portal_connectivity | Direct connection to the GST portal (GSTN / GSP API) | NOT_OFFERED | ZUGEE does not connect to the GST portal. Filing and portal work stay with your accountant. |
| gstr2b_reconciliation | GSTR-2B / input tax credit (ITC) reconciliation | NOT_OFFERED | ZUGEE does not reconcile GSTR-2B or input tax credit. Your accountant does this with their own tools. |
| e_way_bill | E-way bills | UNVERIFIED | I can't confirm e-way bill generation from ZUGEE. Our team can tell you on WhatsApp whether your product supports it. |
| supplier_payments | Automated supplier / vendor payments (bank payouts) | UNVERIFIED | I can't confirm automated supplier payments. ZUGEE products record payments; making bank payouts from ZUGEE is not something I can confirm. |
| partial_payments_other_products | Part payments / instalments in the other products (ZUGEE Water, ZUGEE Omni, ZUGEE Fleet and the rest) | UNVERIFIED | For ZUGEE Water, ZUGEE Omni, ZUGEE Fleet, ZUGEE Tours, ZUGEE Schools, ZUGEE Campus, ZUGEE Care and ZUGEE Factory, I can't confirm part-payment or instalment tracking. They record payments and (where listed) outstanding dues; ask our team whether instalments fit your case. |
| low_stock_alerts | Low-stock alerts | UNVERIFIED | I can't confirm automatic low-stock alerts. Our team can check this for your product. |
| branch_restricted_access | Limiting staff to their own branch's data | UNVERIFIED | Role-based permissions control what each person can see, but I can't confirm that staff can be limited to only their own branch's data. Our team can check this for your product. |
| per_branch_gstin | A separate GSTIN per branch | UNVERIFIED | I can't confirm separate GSTINs per branch. Our team can check this for your product. |
| native_app | A native Android / iOS app from the Play Store or App Store | UNVERIFIED | I can't confirm a separate app-store app; the products run in the phone's browser. |
| driver_app_trip_logging | Drivers logging trips, expenses or proof of delivery on their phones | UNVERIFIED | ZUGEE Fleet runs in a phone browser for office staff and supervisors. Whether drivers log trips, expenses or proof of delivery themselves isn't something I can confirm; our team can check. |
| gps_tracking | Live GPS vehicle tracking | UNVERIFIED | Live GPS tracking is not among ZUGEE Fleet's modules, so I can't confirm it. Ask our team if you need it. |
| data_location | Where data is hosted | UNVERIFIED | I can't say which country the data is kept in. Hosting details are shared on request. |
| offline_use | Working offline | UNVERIFIED | I can't confirm offline use; the products run in a web browser with an internet connection. |
